objective: Falsify or retain the R18 hypothesis that per-call tensor_get, full numeric validation, and JSONL output alter the preceding host/driver gap or cache context enough to contribute to direct jitter.

r18_analysis.finding: R18 diagnostic-quality-rejected runs recorded large outside-graph validation/gap medians, especially around E262144; this is a hypothesis source, not an attribution or a fitted coefficient.

controlled_invariants.original_native_dll: Both arms load the same original frozen native DLL set; copied probe source and rebuilt probe binary are not claimed source/binary equivalent to the original native application.
controlled_invariants.graph_math: same non-inplace SCALE graph, six fixed shapes, constant deterministic input, same graph reuse and buffer allocation policy, unchanged GGML backend/nodes/input.
controlled_invariants.timing: absolute QPC boundaries and the R18 NVTX grammar stay unchanged; each whole-graph call retains exactly one final ggml_backend_synchronize.
controlled_invariants.runtime_hardware: Same inherited environment, native CUDA graph default (GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=null), exact fixed native runtime and external hardware/clock policy; no graph-disabled arm, CUDA event arm, or changed CPU pinning policy.
controlled_invariants.profiling: Direct runs have no CUPTI. Profile runs use NVTX + CUPTI/Nsight node graph trace for actual graph work/submit/overlap accounting. QPC deltas never become GPU time.
controlled_invariants.analysis: Arms are analyzed only as independent native-condition observations. No global LLM-time fit, cost coefficient, or calibration update is permitted.

control.semantics: R18-like: after every timed call write graph-call JSONL, D2H-read and exactly validate final tensor; after first and postformal also D2H-read and exactly validate all intermediate/final tensors.
control.numeric_coverage: all 36 final outputs; all stages at first and postformal
control.allowed_difference: raw arm identity guard only; use same original NVTX label grammar and same timed compute/sync code.

buffered.semantics: Pre-reserve records for all 36 calls. During each phase only perform the timed graph call and its final sync. Do no JSON output or D2H validation inside the 1-call first, 5-call warmup, or 30-call formal phase. Run three exact all-stage numeric blocks after first, after warmup, and after formal; retain FNV-1a raw-byte hashes plus mismatch detail for every stage.
buffered.numeric_coverage: all stages in exactly three phase-boundary blocks; this deliberately does not prove every call numerical.
buffered.interpretation_limit: Timing context differs from control because phase-boundary D2H and output are deferred. A jitter change may be due to this changed context and is not evidence that QPC itself changed or that every call is numerically proven.

execution.full_matrix: After a parent-reviewed decision based on the fixed pilot, a separate amendment may authorize the remaining 6-configuration domain. This revision predeclares but does not launch that expansion.
execution.root_pilot: The only launchable pilot is scale_f32_e262144_g8, both arms, pairs 1..3, direct+profile: 12 native processes and 6 profile exports. It must not silently expand coverage.
execution.sequencing: One GPU-consuming process at a time; alternate arm order within an approved pair; retain all raw output, partial buffers flushed after caught errors, stdout/stderr, launch receipts, trace artifacts, missing/failed/timed-out records and quality rejections.
execution.cache_allocation_reset: Launcher records actual argv and freeze receipt plus graph reuse, buffer allocation, input upload, and reset/no-reset semantics for every arm. No cache sweep or new reset is introduced unless parent records an explicit frozen amendment.

pilot.sequence: Three sequential pairs; for each arm/pair run direct and profile as independently retained executions. No other configuration is launchable by invoke.ps1 in this revision.

raw_schema.hash: FNV-1a 64-bit of the exact host D2H byte buffer; retained for every checked stage and not presented as cryptographic evidence.

native_cpu_pool.applicability: native CPU pool only; synthetic CUDA-only graph creates no CPU worker pool. A single host submitter does not establish 16-thread CPU scheduler equivalence.

runtime.host_scheduling: normal process/thread priority; inherited process affinity captured from runtime. No new CPU pinning policy. Native --cpu-mask applies to CPU worker pool, not a synthetic one-thread backend caller.
runtime.hardware_fingerprint: actual CUDA properties + loaded driver module + external GPU telemetry before/after; expected values are not copied into actual fields

profiler.direct: No Nsight/CUPTI process. Preserve QPC/NVTX only.
profiler.profile: Nsight/CUPTI process, with node-granularity CUDA graph trace; use exact NVTX labels to count actual work, graph launch/capture/update, runtime/driver APIs and overlap.
required_evidence: formal labels each match exactly once
actual child kernel count and actual graph launch/capture/update count from CUPTI
kernel names/grid/block plus explicit dependency validation
host submit, final-sync and GPU/API/idle partitions use Nsight clock only
no substitution of planned GGML nodes for observed dispatch count

quality.clock_policy: Expected SM clock 2400 MHz, retain actual telemetry; tolerance ±30 MHz. Do not change clock, driver, affinity, process priority, or runtime environment.
quality.failure_policy: Retain every failed/partial/missing/unstable artifact and mark it non-eligible. Never delete outliers or emit fitted coefficients.
quality.decision: A/B is a falsification diagnostic. Neither arm may change global LLM timing, native calibration, or cost coefficients.

execution_gate: Parent must review this source/protocol and freeze/launcher integration before any compilation, GPU access, benchmark, inference, or profiler run.
hard_termination_evidence: For buffered hard termination, only prelaunch receipt, frozen identity, and any completed trace artifact are promised. Buffered_started is durably written before timed ordinal 0; unflushed in-memory call records are not recoverable evidence.
